verdict: Ads are back on; leads are arriving but not reaching your pipeline.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta campaign delivered 42 leads at an average cost of $38.68 per lead on $1,624 in total spend. Ads paused for five days mid-period, which compressed the weekly spend figure significantly — but when they resumed on September 14–15, cost per lead dropped to roughly $16, well below the 28-day average, a sign the campaign itself is performing. The more pressing issue is what happens after a lead arrives: your intake system shows none of the 42 leads progressing to an active opportunity, meaning potential cases are going unworked. Automated follow-up tools are being stood up now to close that gap, and a retargeting audience is scheduled to go live by end of September.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period from your active Meta campaign
average cost per lead over the last 28 days, dropping to ~$16 when ads resumed this week
actions taken on your Google Business Profile this period — calls, clicks, and directions

watch_item.issue: Leads are arriving but none are converting into active pipeline opportunities — a confirmed intake gap, not an ads problem.
watch_item.fix: SMS automation and voice access are being deployed now to ensure every incoming lead is contacted and logged promptly.
